The soft, flaky flesh pairs nicely with the scent of the charred shell for a meal that assaults all five of your senses in all the best ways.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Blackened Crabs are a type of [[Roasted Food]]. They are the result of [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} [[Blue Hinox]]es also sometimes drop them when killed. Blackened Crabs have soft, flaky flesh, and smell faintly of charred shell. They are said to assault all five of your senses in the best ways. Eating one will restore one and a half of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Crab * Food * Frozen Crab * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
